_comment: Media coverage of TAAI 2026, listed on press/index.html and zh/press/index.html. List only the outlet, date, original headline and a link to the original article (https only); never copy article text. Fields: id (unique), publishedAt (YYYY-MM-DD), outlet {zh, en}, title (headline as published), language (BCP 47, e.g. zh-Hant, en, ja), url, type (news | interview | feature | broadcast | blog | press-release-repost). Newest first is not required; the page sorts by publishedAt.
